name: @amartinr/pi-deepseek-reasoning-chain-fix
description: Pi Coding Agent extension that fixes the DeepSeek reasoning-chaining contract on tool-calling turns: replays the real reasoning text on continuations, forces non-empty reasoning_content in tool scope, and strips the thinking:disabled kill-switch.
